name: Cyclone Dana — Odisha Coastal Emergency
description: Category 4 tropical cyclone Dana making landfall at Odisha coast near Bhitarkanika. 180+ km/h winds.

timeline.narration: IMD Bhubaneswar: VSCS Cyclone Dana — last position 20.7°N 86.9°E. Landfall in 6 hours. All districts on RED ALERT.
CYCLONE EYE WALL detected on INSAT-3D imagery. Eye diameter 50km. Storm surge 4-6m expected at coast.

fire.reason: INSAT-3D thermal: Cyclone eye-wall convection detected. Intense pressure gradient.
fire.action: Mass coastal evacuation — NDRF pre-positioning required

timeline.narration: CYCLONE EYE: Dana making landfall near Bhitarkanika Mangrove coast. Extreme structural damage risk.
Rain bands spiral detected. Heavy rainfall (200+ mm/6hr) extending 80km from eye. 12 districts impacted.

fire.reason: Kendrapara coast — sea surge inundation 2-3m above mean tide level

timeline.narration: Storm surge hitting Kendrapara coast. 34 fishing villages in direct surge path. ODRAF teams moving.
10km coastal evacuation strip activated. 3.2 lakh people evacuated to 854 cyclone shelters.
Track forecast: Dana to cross coast near Dhamra Port and move NNW. Jharkhand & WB on alert.

fire.reason: Bhadrak district — power infrastructure failure. Substation flooded.
fire.action: State emergency operations — restore critical infrastructure

timeline.narration: Bhadrak — power grid failure. 4 substations flooded. Inland flooding along Baitarani River.
NDRF 2nd Bn pre-positioned at Mundali. 12 teams. Navy + Coast Guard vessels on standby.

timeline.warning: Do NOT enter damaged structures. Aftershock surge possible 3-6hrs post-landfall.
timeline.narration: Multi-agency assets mobilised. State EOC Bhubaneswar fully activated.
IGNIS cyclone response complete. INSAT-3D track updates every 15 min. All agencies coordinated via NCMC.
